KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. zito

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.

3. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.

4. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

6. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

10. When practising Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kuandika 1.3.1 Insha ya wasifu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
